launches.title: Coverage Cat AI Insurance Leaderboard
launches.tagline: How do frontier models perform on complex insurance tasks?
launches.body:
#  Coverage Cat AI Insurance Bench

We’re Coverage Cat. We built an AI insurance benchmark to measure how frontier models perform on real insurance workflows, not trivia or generic reasoning tasks.

### TL;DR

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=106902&key=user_uploads/123258/e54c9091-f0a5-4500-b9f8-125255d46418)

Coverage Cat’s AI Insurance Benchmark compares 7 frontier models on two insurance-specific evals:

* Price estimation: can a model estimate umbrella insurance quote ranges accurately?
* Brokerage/Agent task: can a model answer practical insurance questions the way a good broker or agent would?

The public leaderboard ranks models by Elo Rating, Win Rate, Quote Coverage, Quote MAPE, Winkler Loss, and judged brokerage-task quality.

View it here: Coverage Cat AI Insurance Benchmark (<https://www.coveragecat.com/ai/leaderboard>)

### The Problem

Most AI benchmarks don’t tell you whether a model is useful inside a real insurance workflow or whether consumers can really trust it for insurance information.

Insurance work is full of messy edge cases: pricing uncertainty, underwriting rules, coverage terminology, household risk factors, and questions where the answer needs to be both correct and concise.

There has been good prior work on insurance AI benchmarks, including UNDERWRITE, which evaluates multi-turn underwriting agents with domain experts, noisy tools, and simulated users. That work focuses on enterprise underwriting agent behavior and found meaningful gaps between general model performance and enterprise readiness.

Our benchmark is different: it focuses on consumer insurance workflows Coverage Cat actually needs to automate, including umbrella quote estimation and broker/agent-style answers. It is also designed as a public, continuously updated leaderboard rather than a one-time research benchmark.

### What We Built

The first public version includes:

* 2,800+ price-estimation scenarios
* 19,000+ quote model results
* 1,200+ brokerage/agent task questions
* 8900+ QA model results
* 7 tested models

The benchmark uses anonymized eval data, no-retention/no-logging model platforms, and aggregate-only public snapshots. Customer data is not exposed to model providers.

### What’s Next

We’ll update the leaderboard soon with newer frontier models as they become available through our approved model-provider paths. We also expect to expand the benchmark with more brokerage workflows, richer human review, and additional insurance product lines.

Our goal is simple: make it obvious which AI models are actually good at insurance work and help those models improve.

View the leaderboard: Coverage Cat AI Insurance Benchmark (<https://www.coveragecat.com/ai/leaderboard>)

If you’re shopping for umbrella coverage, you can also start here: Coverage Cat Umbrella Insurance (<https://www.coveragecat.com/insurance-types/umbrella-insurance>).

launches.body:
Coverage Cat, the AI insurance agent, answers any questions you might have about home, auto, umbrella, life, and disability insurance. No more waiting on hold or puzzling over policy jargon. Coverage Cat's assistant can help you figure out if you should buy that policy, file that claim, or shop around for a better price at the click of a button.

---

## Expert Answers for Home, Auto, and Umbrella Insurance

Coverage Cat is trained to provide the right answers about personal lines coverage:

* **Home Insurance**: Learn what your policy covers, from water damage to liability limits.
* **Umbrella Insurance**: Understand when and how your extra liability protection kicks in.
* **Auto Insurance**: Get clear explanations on coverage. Never worry about what collision or comprehensive mean again.

---

## Policy Reviews Powered by AI

Don't get bamboozled by the fine print. Just upload your insurance documents, and Coverage Cat examines policy terms to highlight important coverage details.

---

## Estimates for Claims and Coverage

Curious about how a claim or coverage change might impact your premiums? Coverage Cat can create estimates based on specialized tools tools to offer cost and claims insights. Understand your financial exposure before you make your decisions!

---

## Coverage Cat Saves You Time and Money

Complexity benefits insurers, not policyholders. Coverage Cat leverages our rich insurance data sets to create price transparency, and put valuable information into your hands.

---

## Easy Insurance Conversations Start Now

Insurance need not frustrate. Coverage Cat turns your questions into straightforward answers. Clarity makes all the difference when dealing with a stressful part of your personal finances.

---

## Try Coverage Cat Today!

Just visit us at [coveragecat.com](http://coveragecat.com) where you can get answers and shop for insurance.

launches.body:
Do you have any of: a net worth over $1million; a house; a car; a high paying job? Then Coverage Cat is the best way to buy insurance. We provide **real quotes**, aggressively comparison shop for you across policy types, and **never sell your data**. The result is thousands of dollars saved and weeks of work and phone calls.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65072&key=user_uploads/123258/92e2c8d5-44e3-4cf8-9df6-2ddecf5f19a4)

### Fill out one form and we handle the rest

Don’t waste another minute getting harassed by spam/sales people or figuring out if you bought the right policy. We will shop for you, explain your options, and ensure you get you the best policy for your needs. 

* Need umbrella insurance? Shop and learn on our [explainer page!](https://www.coveragecat.com/umbrella-insurance)
* Need home, car, life, or disability insurance? Visit our [homepage](https://coveragecat.com).
* Want to learn more about insurance? Check out our [blog](https://www.coveragecat.com/blog).
* Live in California or Florida and worried about a price jump or non-renewal on your homeowners insurance? See our reviews of carriers that are still underwriting in both states: [Delos \[CA\]](https://www.coveragecat.com/review/delos), [Bamboo \[CA\]](https://www.coveragecat.com/review/bamboo), [Kin \[FL\]](https://www.coveragecat.com/review/kin).

👋 We’re Max & Gabriel, co-founders of Coverage Cat.

### Opportunity: Insurance - An essential product, often poorly purchased

Insurance is an all-time great financial innovation. It represents a way for people to pool and mitigate significant risks when events have shaken out for the worst. 

But the way insurance is been bought and sold has generated a mismatch between the protection from risk that insurance products SHOULD provide. This forces tens of thousands of people to go bankrupt every year from risks that could be properly insured– Often while overpaying for coverage that doesn't protect them from catastrophic risk.

### Problem: Insurance is complicated

The web of carriers, brokers, contracts, and claims that ensure your risks are properly handled can be an absolute nightmare for people who just want to feel like the things that are important to them are protected.

### The Solution: A one-step process to find the best insurance

We collect information on how much you feel comfortable losing, in addition to standard insurance questions. Coverage Cat’s AI and team of specialists then searches across available carriers to find the policies and prices for your needs. If you’re in CA, FL, NY, TX, or WA we’d appreciate the opportunity to save you a bundle!

Cheers, Max & Gabriel 🐱
